scripts.dev: (bun run gen && bun build --watch portal/index.html --outdir dist) & bun --hot serve.ts
scripts.gen: for f in package/*/*/style.css;do d=${f%/*};c=${d%/*};c=${c##*/};css="$(cat "$f" package/_compat.css)";jq -n --arg s "${d##*/}" --arg c "$c" --arg css "$css" --rawfile sp "$d/spec.md" '{($s):{category:$c,css:$css,spec:$sp}}';done|jq -s add > portal/src/themes.json
scripts.build:lib: rm -rf lib && mkdir lib && for f in package/*/*/style.css;do d=${f%/*};cat "$f" package/_compat.css > "lib/${d##*/}.css";done && bun run gen
scripts.build:portal: rm -rf dist && bun build portal/index.html --outdir dist
scripts.build: bun run build:lib && bun run build:portal
